results.evidence: Third pass (2026-09-30), still one spot-specific author; no ops. Live rows re-read (service key, read-only): all five still hold access.passRequired "Recreation pass" beside access.notes "...is not a developed fee site" and access.parking_pass "Half Moon Crag: no fee site identified." NEW ANGLES, none decisive: (1) The crag guidebook is Weekend Rock Washington (Whitelaw, Mountaineers Books, 2006), which has a HALF MOON CRAGS BETA block ("Getting there: Drive US 2 to Stevens Pass. Half Moon Group: From a junction just 100..."); Google Books full-text queries for that volume with "Northwest Forest Pass", "pass"+"parking" and "hairpin" returned zero hits, and the page preview sits behind a bot check (not bypassed). A zero full-text hit is not a statement that no pass is needed, so it is not counted. (2) King County Old Cascade Scenic Highway Heritage Corridor (Stevens Pass) mile-by-mile tour: describes the hairpin at mile 1.3 and Wellington Trail at mile 2.8 but says nothing about passes or fees anywhere. (3) Federal Register 2022-19186 (MBS proposed new fee sites) lists no site on Old Stevens Pass Hwy/Tye Rd - USFS again, and an absence. (4) Recreation.gov POI for Old Stevens Pass Highway (FS 6099): no fee/pass text; RIDB data is USFS-supplied, not independent. (5) Washington Climbers Coalition: no Stevens Pass/Tye Road page. Mountain Project Stevens Pass Boulders parks at the PCT lot, not this pull-off. (6) No WTA, NWHikers, CascadeClimbers or reddit report found naming parking at the Tye Road hairpin pull-off and a pass either way; the WTA pass mentions on Tye Road are for the Wellington/Iron Goat trailheads (listed fee sites), not this pull-off. Seattle Times mile-by-mile Stevens Pass guide returned 403. Net: the only spot-specific evidence remains USFS (fee-site list omits the pull-off; FS 6099 page has no fee section) - one author. Not confirmed under the two-source rule. Owner note unchanged: the row contradicts itself; if a second source appears the op is passRequired "Recreation pass" -> a no-pass value on these five rows only; access.fees and access._raw untouched.
